Subject: Feedback regarding my recent stay - Exceptional Service

Dear [Hotel Manager's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I received during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived until my departure, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the contributions of [Employee Name 1] and [Employee Name 2]. Their attentiveness, professionalism, and warm hospitality truly made my stay memorable. It is rare to encounter such genuine dedication to guest experience, and it did not go unnoticed.

Because of the outstanding experience I had, I will certainly be recommending your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to returning in the future.

Thank you again for your team's hard work and commitment to excellence.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]
